            + b" p95=" + str(pct(95)).encode()
            + b" max=" + str(t[-1]).encode()

        n = len(times)

            p,
            n,
            nearest_rank(times, 50),

            if not m:
                cur[2] = True
                continue
            n = int(m.group(2))
            if n <= 0:
                cur[2] = True
                continue
            cur[1].append((parts[0], n if m.group(1) == '+' else -n))

    cache = {}
    for k, v in state.get("items", []):
        cache[k] = v

    misses = int(state.get("misses", 0))

    parts = first.split()
    capacity = int(parts[1]) if len(parts) >= 2 else 1
    if capacity < 1:
        capacity = 1

    def evict_one():
        nonlocal evictions
        k = next(iter(cache))
        del cache[k]
        evictions += 1
        out.append("evict " + k)

        evict_one()

        line = lines[idx]

            else:

QTY_RE = re.compile(r"-?[0-9]+")
PRICE_RE = re.compile(r"([0-9]+)(?:\.([0-9]{1,2}))?")


def parse(s):
    """Parse RFC 4180 text into a list of (fields, malformed) records."""
    records = []
    n = len(s)
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        # An empty line between records is skipped.
        if s[i] == "\n":
            i += 1
            continue
        if s.startswith("\r\n", i):
            i += 2
            continue
        fields = []
        bad = False
        while True:
            if i < n and s[i] == '"':
                # Quoted field: runs to the closing quote; "" is one quote.
                j = i + 1
                buf = []
                closed = False
                while j < n:
                    c = s[j]
                    if c == '"':
                        if j + 1 < n and s[j + 1] == '"':
                            buf.append('"')
                            j += 2
                        else:
                            j += 1
                            closed = True
                            break
                    else:
                        buf.append(c)
                        j += 1
                if not closed:
                    # Still open at the end of the file.
                    bad = True
                    fields.append("".join(buf))
                    i = n
                    break
                i = j
                if not (i >= n or s[i] == "," or s[i] == "\n" or s.startswith("\r\n", i)):
                    # Text after the closing quote, as in "a"b.
                    bad = True
                    k = i
                    while k < n and s[k] != "," and s[k] != "\n" and not s.startswith("\r\n", k):
                        k += 1
                    buf.append(s[i:k])
                    i = k
                fields.append("".join(buf))
            else:
                k = i
                while k < n and s[k] != "," and s[k] != "\n" and not s.startswith("\r\n", k):
                    k += 1
                f = s[i:k]
                if '"' in f:
                    bad = True
                fields.append(f)
                i = k
            if i < n and s[i] == ",":
                i += 1
                continue
            if i < n and s[i] == "\n":
                i += 1
            elif s.startswith("\r\n", i):
                i += 2

        records.append((fields, bad))

        body = recs[1:]

import sys


def parse(text):
    """Yield (fields, malformed) per record, skipping empty lines."""
    i = 0
    n = len(text)
    while i < n:
        # Empty line?
        if text[i] == "\n":
            i += 1
            continue
        if text[i] == "\r" and i + 1 < n and text[i + 1] == "\n":
            i += 2
            continue
        fields = []
        bad = False
        end_record = False
        while not end_record:
            buf = []
            if i < n and text[i] == '"':
                i += 1
                closed = False
                while i < n:
                    c = text[i]
                    if c == '"':
                        if i + 1 < n and text[i + 1] == '"':
                            buf.append('"')
                            i += 2
                            continue
                        i += 1
                        closed = True
                        break
                    buf.append(c)
                    i += 1
                if not closed:
                    bad = True
                    fields.append("".join(buf))
                    end_record = True
                    break
            # unquoted part (or trailing junk after closing quote)
            started_quoted = bool(buf) or (i > 0 and text[i - 1] == '"')
            while i < n:
                c = text[i]
                if c == ",":
                    break
                if c == "\n":
                    break
                if c == "\r" and i + 1 < n and text[i + 1] == "\n":
                    break
                if c == '"':
                    bad = True
                elif started_quoted:
                    bad = True
                buf.append(c)
                i += 1
            fields.append("".join(buf))
            if i >= n:
                end_record = True
            elif text[i] == ",":
                i += 1
                if i >= n:
                    fields.append("")
                    end_record = True
            elif text[i] == "\n":
                i += 1
                end_record = True
            else:  # CRLF
                i += 2
                end_record = True
        yield fields, bad


def fixed_parse(text):
    # Wrapper tracking whether a field was quoted, to detect junk after quote reliably.
    return parse(text)


QTY = re.compile(r"-?[0-9]+")
PRICE = re.compile(r"([0-9]+)(?:\.([0-9]{1,2}))?")


def quote(f):
    if any(ch in f for ch in ',"\r\n'):
        return '"' + f.replace('"', '""') + '"'
    return f


def fmt_cents(c):
    sign = "-" if c < 0 else ""
    c = abs(c)
    return "%s%d.%02d" % (sign, c // 100, c % 100)


def bkey(s):

import json
import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request


def is_int(v):
    return isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool)


def classify(ch):
    if not isinstance(ch, dict):
        return None
    op = ch.get("op")
    sku = ch.get("sku")
    ver = ch.get("version")
    if not isinstance(sku, str) or not is_int(ver):
        return None
    if op == "upsert":
        name = ch.get("name")
        qty = ch.get("qty")
        if not isinstance(name, str) or not is_int(qty):
            return None
        return ("upsert", sku, name, qty, ver)
    if op == "delete":
        return ("delete", sku, None, None, ver)
    return None


def main():
    try:
        sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
    except Exception:
        pass
    base = os.environ["API"].rstrip("/")
    db_path = os.environ["DB"]
    key = os.environ.get("API_KEY", "")

    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path, isolation_level=None)
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS state (k TEXT PRIMARY KEY, v TEXT NOT NULL)")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS versions (sku TEXT PRIMARY KEY, version INTEGER NOT NULL)")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (sku TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, qty INTEGER NOT NULL)")

    row = conn.execute("SELECT v FROM state WHERE k='cursor'").fetchone()
    cursor = row[0] if row else "0"

    pages = applied = stale = invalid = 0
    end_msg = None

    while True:
        url = base + "/changes?cursor=" + urllib.parse.quote(str(cursor), safe="")
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, method="GET",
                                     headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + key})
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
                status = resp.status
                body = resp.read()
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            end_msg = "stopped at %s (status %d)" % (cursor, e.code)
            break
        except Exception:
            end_msg = "stopped at %s (no response)" % cursor
            break
        if status != 200:
            end_msg = "stopped at %s (status %d)" % (cursor, status)
            break
        try:
            data = json.loads(body.decode("utf-8"))
        except Exception:
            data = None
        if not isinstance(data, dict) or not isinstance(data.get("changes"), list):
            end_msg = "stopped at %s (invalid page)" % cursor
            break
        nxt = data.get("next")
        if nxt is not None and not isinstance(nxt, (str, int)) or isinstance(nxt, bool):
            end_msg = "stopped at %s (invalid page)" % cursor
            break

        a = s = i = 0
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            for ch in data["changes"]:
                c = classify(ch)
                if c is None:
                    i += 1
                    continue
                op, sku, name, qty, ver = c
                r = conn.execute("SELECT version FROM versions WHERE sku=?", (sku,)).fetchone()
                if r is not None and ver <= r[0]:
                    s += 1
                    continue
                conn.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO versions (sku, version) VALUES (?, ?)", (sku, ver))
                if op == "upsert":
                    conn.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO items (sku, name, qty) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                                 (sku, name, qty))
                else:
                    conn.execute("DELETE FROM items WHERE sku=?", (sku,))
                a += 1
            new_cursor = str(cursor) if nxt is None else str(nxt)
            conn.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO state (k, v) VALUES ('cursor', ?)", (new_cursor,))
            conn.execute("COMMIT")
        except Exception:
            conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            raise
        pages += 1
        applied += a
        stale += s
        invalid += i
        if nxt is None:
            end_msg = "complete"
            break
        cursor = str(nxt)

    print("pages %d applied %d stale %d invalid %d" % (pages, applied, stale, invalid))
    print(end_msg)
    rows = conn.execute("SELECT sku, qty, name FROM items").fetchall()
    rows.sort(key=lambda r: r[0].encode("utf-8"))
    for sku, qty, name in rows:
        print("%s %d %s" % (sku, qty, name))
    conn.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
